## Metrics across runs

```{python}
#| label: plot
import json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
from sconixlib.viz import use_style
use_style()
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
for d in sorted(Path("results").glob("*/")):
    mp = d / "metrics.jsonl"
    if not mp.exists():
        continue
    rows = [json.loads(x) for x in mp.read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()]
    ycol = next((k for k in ("loss", "metric") if any(k in r for r in rows)), None)
    if ycol:
        ax.plot([r.get("step") for r in rows if ycol in r],
                [r[ycol] for r in rows if ycol in r], label=d.name)
ax.set_xlabel("step"); ax.set_ylabel("loss / metric"); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
plt.show()
```
